name: Echoes of Aether - cyberpunk vehicle kit
generator: blender/vehicles (Blender 5.2, headless, procedural). Rebuild: see VEHICLES.md

conventions.units: metres; FBX exported with apply_scale_options=FBX_SCALE_ALL, bake_space_transform=True, axis_forward=-Z, axis_up=Y -> import at scale 1, identity rotation
conventions.axes: Unity Y up, vehicle FRONT = +Z, right = +X. Pivot = ground centre (bounds centre in X/Z, y = 0 at the lowest point: tyres / thruster pods / hull).
conventions.hierarchy: <Name>_LOD0/1/2 body meshes at the root; animated parts are empties at their pivot (Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR, Wheel_F/R for the bike, Thruster_* for flyers) each with <Part>_LOD0/1/2 mesh children at identity local transform.
conventions.lods: LOD1 ~40% and LOD2 ~12% of LOD0 triangles (body + parts). Assign each <Part>_LODn renderer to LOD n of the root LODGroup.
conventions.uv0: World-scale metres (box projection) for tiling materials; tiling = 1 / tileSizeMeters. 'fit' materials (veh_decal atlas, veh_navlight, veh_holo_sign) use authored 0..1 UVs.
conventions.normals: Custom split normals (smooth, sharp > 38 deg) exported; ModelImporter normals = Import, tangents = Calculate Mikktspace.
conventions.materialSlots: Material slot names == material names below (all prefixed veh_); remap FBX materials by name.
conventions.colliders: Suggested box colliders in Unity local space (center/size in metres).
conventions.lights: Anchor points (Unity local) for spot/point lights: headlight / taillight centres plus every light unit under 'all'.

textures.BaseColor: sRGB RGB (RGBA for veh_glass_cracked / veh_holo_sign: A = opacity). URP Lit _BaseMap.
textures.Normal: Tangent-space, OpenGL (+Y up) = Unity convention. Import as Normal map. URP Lit _BumpMap.
textures.MaskMap: Linear RGBA: R = metallic, G = ambient occlusion, B = unused (0), A = smoothness. URP Lit _MetallicGlossMap, Smoothness Source = Metallic Alpha, _Smoothness = 1. URP samples occlusion from .g if MaskMap is also set as _OcclusionMap.
textures.Emission: sRGB RGB emission colour (emissive materials only). URP Lit _EmissionMap, _EmissionColor = white * emissionIntensity (HDR).

all.maxSize: desktop 2048 (body paints / wreck / burnt are 2K), WebGL 1024
